title: Minimal Repair: LLM Entity-ID Wiring for Causal Integration
source: Cognitive Value Diagnosis (post-D8): 30-episode regression showed FULL_RAPHAEL mean=0.500 == NO_LLM mean=0.500. Cognitive trace of T3 episode confirmed 3/4 LLM SemanticInferenceSuccess objects consumed by HypothesisManager with semantic_inference_ids, but zero PlanDecisions carried semantic_inference_driven rationale code. Root cause: entity_ids=[] hardcoded at arena/ablation_runner.py:870.
defect_statement: At arena/ablation_runner.py:868-872, runner.hypothesis_manager.consume_semantic_inference() is called with entity_ids=[], a hardcoded empty list. The comment reads '# Will be populated from evidence context' but this population was never implemented. The HypothesisManager correctly stores entity_ids in the Hypothesis object (hypothesis.py:482) and indexes hypotheses by entity_id (hypothesis.py:504-507). The Planner's scoring boost at action.py:890 checks c['target'] in hyp.entity_ids — this check NEVER fires because entity_ids is always empty. Additionally, the alternate boost path at action.py:895 (evidence-seeking action types) was closed by D8's scope filter. Result: LLM-derived hypotheses enter the HypothesisManager with semantic_inference_ids, are passed to the Planner via hypothesis_ids, but have zero behavioral effect. The LLM is causally isolated from action selection.

diagnostic_evidence.confirmed_via: D8 cognitive trace (T3 episode, seed 952316315): 3 SemanticInferenceSuccess produced with inference_ids ['si_5e401ce99b62', 'si_9e3891b07c6b', 'si_a8ad6f14cd2b']. All 3 consumed by HypothesisManager.consume_semantic_inference(). All 3 hypotheses have entity_ids=[]. Planner Decision 1 receives hypothesis_ids=['hyp_e33916dd535d', 'hyp_9a02fcdb54c3', 'hyp_a926dfc9ed10'] with semantic_inference_ids but applies zero semantic_inference_driven rationale codes. Entity_ids remain empty throughout episode.
diagnostic_evidence.defect_location: arena/ablation_runner.py:870 — entity_ids=[] hardcoded in the consume_semantic_inference() call within the cognitive loop.
diagnostic_evidence.existing_infrastructure: WorldModel.entities (world.py:242) is a dict[str, Entity]. Each Entity.evidence_ids (world.py:108) lists evidence IDs linked to that entity. WorldModel.relationships (world.py:243) also carry evidence_ids (world.py:137). The mapping from evidence_id -> entity_ids already exists in the data but is never queried. Entities are created with evidence_ids at ablation_runner.py:1935, 1951, 1967.
diagnostic_evidence.causal_chain_before_repair: LLM -> SemanticInferenceSuccess -> HypothesisManager(consume, entity_ids=[]) -> Hypothesis(entity_ids=[]) -> Planner.decide(c['target'] in hyp.entity_ids) -> NEVER MATCHES -> no semantic_inference_driven boost -> FULL == NO_LLM

change_objective: Populate entity_ids in the consume_semantic_inference() call at ablation_runner.py:868-872 with WorldModel entity IDs derived from the observation's evidence context. When the LLM produces a SemanticInferenceSuccess about evidence E (identified by obs_evidence_ids), resolve the WorldModel entities whose evidence_ids overlap with obs_evidence_ids. This completes the contract left open by the comment '# Will be populated from evidence context'.
invariant_to_establish: When the LLM produces a SemanticInferenceSuccess about evidence E, the resulting Hypothesis must contain entity_ids that reference the WorldModel entities associated with evidence E via the entity.evidence_ids field. The semantic_inference_driven rationale code must appear in at least one PlanDecision per FULL_RAPHAEL episode where the LLM is invoked.

architectural_constraint.entity_ids_from_existing_world_model_sta: entity_ids must be resolved by scanning WorldModel.entities for entities whose evidence_ids overlap with obs_evidence_ids. This is a query of existing state, not entity resolution logic. Do NOT create new entity resolution algorithms.
architectural_constraint.additional_entity_ids_from_relationships: If a relationship's evidence_ids overlaps with obs_evidence_ids, both the source and target entity should also be included in entity_ids. This captures entities linked by relationships grounded in the same evidence.
architectural_constraint.no_fabrication: Do not fabricate entity IDs. Do not create entities. Do not resolve targets from IP strings or hostnames in the observation. Only use the WorldModel's existing entity-to-evidence associations.
architectural_constraint.de_duplication: Ensure entity_ids contains no duplicates. Use a set before converting to list.
architectural_constraint.no_world_model_modification: WorldModel must not be modified. No new methods, no new indexes. The resolution is done inline in ablation_runner.py by iterating over existing WorldModel state.
architectural_constraint.empty_entity_ids_is_safe_fallback: If obs_evidence_ids is empty, or if no WorldModel entities reference any evidence ID in obs_evidence_ids, entity_ids=[] is correct (falls back to current behavior). The Planner's boost simply won't fire for that hypothesis.

change_logic.step_2: Before the consume_semantic_inference call, resolve entity_ids from obs_evidence_ids using WorldModel state:
change_logic.step_3: Replace entity_ids=[] with entity_ids=<resolved_list> in the consume_semantic_inference() call.

edge_cases.behavior: entity_ids resolves to []. consume_semantic_inference receives entity_ids=[]. Planner boost does not fire. Falls back to current (pre-D9) behavior. This is safe.
edge_cases.verification: Empty obs_evidence_ids should not occur when LLM is invoked with >= 3 evidence items, but guard handles it.

edge_cases.case: obs_evidence_ids don't match any WorldModel entity's evidence_ids
edge_cases.behavior: entity_ids resolves to []. The entity creation pattern (ablation_runner.py:1935) always links entities to their discovery evidence, so this should not happen in practice unless the evidence is very stale and entities were garbage-collected.
edge_cases.verification: If it does happen (e.g., test harness without entity creation), the empty list is safe.

edge_cases.case: Multiple entities share the same evidence_id
edge_cases.behavior: Both entity IDs are included (deduplicated via set). The Planner's c['target'] in hyp.entity_ids check will match any of them. Correct behavior.
edge_cases.verification: The entity_ids list may contain 2+ IDs for evidence shared across entities (e.g., IP and hostname entities from same observation).

edge_cases.case: Relationships reference obs_evidence_ids but entities don't
edge_cases.behavior: Source and target entity IDs from matching relationships are appended. This catches cases where the relationship is the primary evidence holder (e.g., a CONNECTS_TO relationship established from the observation).
edge_cases.verification: Edge case: relationship evidence_ids may overlap but entity.evidence_ids may not. Both sources are checked.

edge_cases.case: Target of the candidate does not match any resolved entity_id
edge_cases.behavior: The c['target'] in hyp.entity_ids check does not fire for that candidate. Other candidates targeting matching entities may still get the boost. No crash, no error.
edge_cases.verification: This is expected when the candidate targets a different entity than the one the LLM analyzed. The boost is specific to relevant candidates.

edge_cases.case: LLM is invoked multiple times per iteration (loop over evidence_texts)
edge_cases.behavior: The break at line 882 limits to one observation per iteration. Each invocation resolves entity_ids independently. No interference between iterations.
edge_cases.verification: The entity_ids resolution is local to each LLM call and does not persist across iterations.
